summary: Ikizahra Laundry Website is a full-stack Internet Computer (Motoko canister) + React/TypeScript web application for a laundry business. It provides a public marketing site (hero banner, gallery, services/pricing, contact section, footer) and a set of admin-only management capabilities gated by Internet Identity + RBAC. Admins can manage service catalogs (online and in-store subcategories), upload and manage images (hero and gallery, plus per-service images) with client-side processing (crop to aspect ratio + JPEG compression) and upload progress, edit image descriptions, configure background pattern/theme settings stored in the canister, and update contact information. The backend also includes a Caffeine blob-storage mixin for blob lifecycle/cleanup workflows and gateway authorization management.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider
existing_features.description: Provides a React context around @dfinity/auth-client to initialize/load stored sessions, login via Internet Identity, logout/clear identity, and expose detailed login status flags.

existing_features.title: Login/logout UI with cache clearing
existing_features.description: Renders a login/logout button that triggers Internet Identity login or logout; clears the React Query cache on logout to remove identity-scoped data.

existing_features.title: Identity-aware canister actor creation and refresh
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous canister actor when unauthenticated and an identity-backed actor when authenticated; calls initializeAccessControl on authenticated actor creation and invalidates/refetches all other queries when the actor changes.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (admin/user/guest)
existing_features.description: Motoko AccessControl assigns roles (first initialized principal becomes admin, subsequent principals become users) and enforces permission checks for admin-only endpoints; includes endpoints to query caller role/admin status and assign roles to other principals.

existing_features.title: User profile storage and first-login profile setup modal
existing_features.description: Authenticated users can save and retrieve a simple profile (name, phoneNumber). The frontend prompts users to complete their profile when authenticated and no profile exists.

existing_features.title: Public services listing with pricing and WhatsApp ordering links
existing_features.description: Fetches services by category/subcategory and renders responsive service cards with IDR currency formatting and a per-service WhatsApp deep link containing a prefilled Indonesian order message.

existing_features.title: Admin CRUD for online services
existing_features.description: Admins can create, edit, and delete services in the online category; the UI provides dialogs for add/edit/delete and refreshes cached service queries after mutations.

existing_features.title: Admin CRUD for in-store services by subcategory
existing_features.description: Admins can create, edit, and delete in-store services split into selfService and operatorService subcategories; the UI renders the two subcategories separately and refreshes cached queries after mutations.

existing_features.title: Admin service image upload (online and in-store) with processing and progress
existing_features.description: Admins can upload a processed image for a service; the frontend validates and crops/compresses to a selected aspect ratio, then uploads via ExternalBlob with progress tracking; the processed image metadata is stored on the service record.

existing_features.title: Public gallery display with admin caption editing
existing_features.description: Displays gallery-type images in a responsive grid with hover effects; admins can edit an image description via a dialog and updates invalidate image queries so changes appear immediately.

existing_features.title: Admin gallery management (upload, replace, delete, edit descriptions)
existing_features.description: Provides an admin-only page to manage gallery images: upload new images with selectable aspect ratio, replace an existing photo while preserving metadata, delete images with confirmation, and edit descriptions. Upload/replace flows include client-side processing and upload progress with cache invalidation to refresh the gallery instantly.

existing_features.title: Hero banner image retrieval and admin editor
existing_features.description: The hero section loads the latest hero-type processed image from the backend (fallback to a local asset). Admins can open a dialog to upload a new hero banner image with aspect ratio selection, description, client-side processing, and progress tracking.

existing_features.title: Processed image model and image APIs
existing_features.description: Backend defines a ProcessedImage type (blob + metadata such as aspect ratio, size, dimensions, type) and exposes APIs to list images, filter by type, upload images for several types (gallery/hero/logo/contact background), and update descriptions (admin-only where applicable).

existing_features.title: Contact information (public read, admin update)
existing_features.description: Backend stores contact info (phone, WhatsApp link, address, hours) readable publicly and editable by admins. The AdminPanel includes an edit dialog and invalidates the contactInfo query on save.

existing_features.title: Contact form submission and admin viewing APIs
existing_features.description: Backend supports storing contact form entries (name/phone/message) and admin-only retrieval of entries. Frontend query/mutation hooks exist for submission and admin listing (UI usage may vary).

existing_features.title: Background theme customization persisted in canister
existing_features.description: Admins can configure background pattern type, base color, transparency, and intensity stored in the canister. The frontend applies these as CSS variables and pattern classes (bubbles/fabric/ripples) to site sections.

existing_features.title: Client-side primary theme hue customization (localStorage)
existing_features.description: AdminPanel provides preset and custom hue controls that update OKLCH-based CSS variables for site theming and persist the selected hue to localStorage.

existing_features.title: Customer photo upload with progress and admin-only retrieval endpoints
existing_features.description: Public UI allows users to upload a photo with client-side validation, preview, and progress tracking via ExternalBlob. Backend stores uploaded photos and provides admin-only endpoints to fetch a photo by id and list all photo IDs.

existing_features.title: Centralized React Query hook layer for canister operations
existing_features.description: Implements a comprehensive set of typed query/mutation hooks covering profiles, admin checks, services, images (upload/update/delete/replace), contact info, contact submissions, background theme, and customer photo upload, with consistent cache invalidation.

existing_features.title: Client-side image processing utilities (aspect-ratio crop + compression)
existing_features.description: Utilities validate image files (type/size), format file sizes, and process images into fixed aspect ratios (1:1, 4:3, 9:16) using Canvas with JPEG compression; returns bytes and metadata used by upload flows.

existing_features.title: Blob-storage maintenance endpoints via Caffeine storage mixin
existing_features.description: Includes mixin endpoints for checking blob liveness, listing dead blobs (authorized gateways only), confirming deletions (pruning + GC trigger), refreshing gateway principals via a cashier canister, and refilling the cashier with cycles under strict caller checks.

existing_features.title: Header navigation and gallery-management view toggle (event-based)
existing_features.description: Implements fixed responsive navigation with smooth scrolling to sections and an event-based toggle that switches GalleryDisplay into the admin GalleryManagementPage without introducing a router.

existing_features.title: URL parameter and hash-secret utilities
existing_features.description: Provides helpers to read URL params from query or hash, persist values to sessionStorage, and extract+clear sensitive parameters from the hash fragment to reduce leakage risk.

existing_features.title: Responsive marketing site composition and styling
existing_features.description: Composes the end-to-end site layout (Header, Hero, Gallery, Services, Contact, AdminPanel, Footer) and applies Tailwind-based responsive styling, OKLCH theme variables, reusable gradient utilities, and patterned section overlays.

existing_features.title: Update all gallery image description displays to support very long text without being cut off. Remove any UI truncation (e.g., Tailwind `line-clamp-*`) and ensure descriptions wrap across multiple lines (use word-breaking and preserve line breaks where relevant). This applies to: public gallery cards, admin gallery management cards, and featured gallery cards.

Ensure all description editing inputs support long, multi-sentence text comfortably. Use multiline inputs everywhere descriptions are edited and ensure there is no client-side `maxLength` or other artificial limit that prevents long descriptions from being entered and saved.

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow much longer (effectively unlimited) text in all editable descriptions (gallery image descriptions, service descriptions, page/below-section descriptions) so sentences are not cut off; update UI to use multiline inputs and backend/storage limits accordingly.
Add per-service 'Pesan' / order button on each price-list item (online + in-place categories) that deep-links to WhatsApp with prefilled message for the selected service.

Replace/remove the bottom 'Kirim Pesan' customer contact form section and instead show a same-sized customer photo upload/gallery section (upload + manage images) in that area, without removing other existing features/content.

architectural_notes: Frontend uses React + TypeScript with @tanstack/react-query; all canister calls are wrapped in typed query/mutation hooks (frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts) with explicit cache invalidation.
Authentication is implemented via DFINITY Internet Identity using @dfinity/auth-client, exposed through a React context provider (InternetIdentityProvider).

A dedicated actor hook (useActor) creates either an anonymous or identity-backed canister actor; on authenticated creation it calls initializeAccessControl, and on actor changes it invalidates/refetches other queries.
UI is built with TailwindCSS (OKLCH CSS variables) and shadcn/ui components; the site uses reusable gradient/pattern utilities for a consistent “luxury” theme.
Images are processed client-side using Canvas (object-fit: cover crop to chosen aspect ratio, then JPEG compression) and uploaded as ExternalBlob with progress callbacks.
Backend is a single Motoko canister storing state in mo:core/Map structures and enforcing permissions via an AccessControl module.

Backend includes a blob-storage mixin (backend/blob-storage/Mixin.mo) exposing maintenance endpoints for dead-blob listing, deletion confirmation, gateway principal refresh, and cycles top-ups via a cashier canister.
Navigation to the gallery admin page is done without a router using a CustomEvent (galleryPageChange) dispatched by Header and consumed by GalleryDisplay.
known_issues: Backend ID generation is inconsistent and can collide/reuse IDs after deletions: services and many image uploads use map.size()+1 (e.g., uploadHeroImage/uploadLogoImage), while gallery uploads use nextGalleryImageId; none are initialized from existing state on upgrade.
submitContactForm likely returns an incorrect ID: it inserts using contactEntries.size()+1 and then returns contactEntries.size()+1 again after insertion (off-by-one / mismatch risk).
getOrderedGalleryImages does not actually order results and returns all processed images in Map iteration order (not guaranteed), despite the name implying ordering and “gallery-only” semantics.

deleteGalleryImage only removes the metadata record; it does not ensure the underlying blob is pruned/removed, so the previous blob may remain accessible depending on storage semantics and pruning workflows.

deleteGalleryImage and replaceGalleryImage do not validate that the target record is a gallery image (imageType); they can be called with any ProcessedImage id and may delete/overwrite non-gallery records.
Contact UI shows hardcoded visible phone/address/hours strings; backend updates to ContactInfo may not fully reflect in displayed text (links partly use contactInfo, but displayed text does not).
GalleryManagementPage does not revoke created object URLs on reset/close for previewUrl/replacePreviewUrl, which can cause memory leaks during repeated uploads/replacements.
Access control bootstrapping makes the first authenticated principal to call initializeAccessControl the admin; if an unintended principal initializes first, admin ownership can be hijacked.
Public uploadCustomerPhoto endpoint has no rate limiting/abuse protection and minimal server-side validation (client validates type/size, but backend accepts arbitrary blobs).

Blob-storage gateway authorization list is stored in transient state; after deployment/upgrade it may be empty until _caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals is called, causing pruning/listing endpoints to trap as unauthorized.
